Name: (CP) Sam Thinking Portrait Patch
Author: TeacupCreations
Description:
Ever wonder why Sam turns into sonic insetad of super saiyan in one of his portraits? Why does he suddenly lose the front part of his hair?
Well I'm here to fix that.
This mod replaces that portrait with one that more in keeping with the rest. This includes all vanilla portrait variants available at the time of posting.

That's it.

Downloads.Description: Extract into your mods folder to install.

Manifest.Name: (CP) Sam Thinking Portrait Patch
Manifest.Description: Replaces Sam's thinking portraits to be more in keeping with the rest of his portraits.
